description: This Java class 'MessageCommandAckRequestSetter' extends an abstract class to set acknowledgment requests on message commands. It provides mechanism to add acknowledgment headers indicating live response willingness, following the Eclipse Ditto framework conventions.

classes.name: MessageCommandAckRequestSetter
classes.description: Implements a singleton that sets acknowledgment requests on MessageCommand objects to enable live response acknowledgments within the Ditto framework.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MessageCommandAckRequestSetter.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the provided MessageCommand is applicable for setting the acknowledgment request.

methods.name: getMatchedClass
methods.description: Returns the class type that this setter is designed to handle, in this case, MessageCommand.

methods.name: isBindResponseRequiredToAddingRemovingImplicitLabel
methods.description: Indicates whether bind response is required for adding/removing implicit labels, returns true.
